featured_reviews.review_text: 10 pin Bowling in TimeZone. On Thursdays there is a waiting line of 200 people. Waiting time varies from 2 hours to 5 hours. featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an awesome time at Timezone Sky City! The bowling alley was fantastic—clean, fun, and really well-maintained. The atmosphere was energetic and perfect for a great day out.

A special shout-out to Irsad, who provided exceptional service. He was friendly, helpful, and made the experience even better with his professionalism and positive attitude. Staff like him truly make a difference!

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fun activities and great customer service.

If you want it shorter, more formal, or more enthusiastic, just let me know!🤩💯

featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Sky City Mall, and it honestly exceeded my expectations. If you love a mix of premium shopping, great coffee, and a classy aesthetic, this place is a must-visit. Here is a quick look at my experience:
Premium Ambiance: The mall is beautifully designed and feels very upscale. The Starbucks has a fantastic, cozy setup that's perfect for relaxing over a premium brew.
Top-Tier Fashion: Shopping here is a breeze. Stores like Superdry have incredible collections and an amazing urban studio vibe with stunning lighting.
Quality Footwear & Accessories: I was highly impressed by the Bugatti store. Their display of shoes, sleek leather bags, and accessories is incredibly well-curated and premium.
Great Refreshment Choices: From energy drinks to unique non-alcoholic craft beverages, there’s plenty of variety to keep you refreshed while you explore.
Highly Recommended: Clean, well-organized, and packed with authentic global brands. Definitely worth spending your weekend here!

featured_reviews.name: Nasir Siddiqui
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Sky City Mall recently and had a great experience overall. The mall is very spacious, clean, and well maintained. One thing I really liked was the large parking area — there is plenty of space for both cars and bikes, so parking was easy. Parking is paid though, and I paid ₹40 for bike parking.

The food court is excellent with many good food options and a nice seating area. Perfect place to relax and spend time with friends or family. The play zone and entertainment area are also very enjoyable, especially for kids and gaming lovers.

The overall ambience of the mall feels modern and premium. Good place for shopping, food, movies, and weekend outings. Definitely worth visiting if you are in Borivali East.

featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience at Sky City Mall this Sunday. The mall is clean, well-maintained, and has a vibrant atmosphere. Enjoyed tasty food at KFC and Subway. The IMAX is also available, making it a great spot for movie lovers. There are plenty of branded stores for sports shoes and wearables, and fun gaming options too. Sky City Mall is a modern and well-planned shopping destination, but visitors should be prepared for a bit of walking. The parking arrangement is spacious and organized separately for cars and two-wheelers. However, after parking, you may need to walk a considerable distance to reach the main mall entrance. Additionally, the exit points for bikes and cars are different, which can be slightly confusing for first-time visitors, especially during peak hours.
One of the major advantages of this mall is its excellent connectivity. There is a direct connecting bridge from Devi Pada Metro Station, making it extremely convenient for people using public transport. This feature adds significant value, particularly for daily commuters and shoppers who want to avoid traffic and parking hassles.
The mall houses a wide range of popular brands, covering fashion, lifestyle, electronics, and daily needs. Almost all well-known brands are available, making it a good one-stop destination for shopping. For entertainment lovers, the presence of INOX and PVR cinemas is a big plus, offering a premium movie-watching experience with good sound and seating comfort.
However, the seating capacity in common areas and food court zones feels limited compared to the overall size of the mall. During weekends and holidays, finding a place to sit can be difficult. Despite this, the mall maintains a clean environment, good lighting, and a pleasant ambience.
Overall, Sky City Mall Borivali is a well-connected, brand-rich mall ideal for shopping and movies, though better seating arrangements and clearer parking navigation would further enhance the visitor experience.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst birthday experience ever.

Despite booking and paying in advance for a table and a bowling alley, we faced constant pushing and overcrowding (dhakka-mukki) throughout the evening. I raised the issue multiple times in advance with both the lady and male bouncers, yet every complaint was ignored.

Shockingly, one bouncer was openly encouraging other people to play for free on our paid bowling lane. PR staff casually brought their girlfriends to our table and bowling area, and one PR even took drinks from our table without permission.

To make matters worse, a man wearing a sleeveless vest (sando) — clearly allowed by this “sando-only club of Mumbai” — used extremely abusive and vulgar language, including offensive remarks involving mothers. What is most disturbing is that PRs, bouncers, and even one of the owners present at the time witnessed everything and chose to do nothing. They simply stood there and watched.

Let’s be honest — if such language had been used toward your sister or girlfriend, it would never have been tolerated. Stand for the truth.

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Kinkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Timezone at Phoenix Palladium is hands-down one of the best spots in Mumbai for a fun day out. Tucked away on the Third Floor of the East Wing, it is incredibly easy to find and offers a massive variety of games that keep both kids and adults thoroughly entertained.The arcade selection here is top-notch. They have the latest immersive VR games like Virtual Rabbids and Dark Mars VR, which are absolutely thrilling. Beyond video games, the social play options are fantastic. We had an incredible time hitting the bowling lanes and driving the bumper cars, making it the perfect spot to hang out with a group of friends or family. It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. The Singapore Swimming Club, a prestigious recreational destination known for offering premium leisure experiences, aimed to modernize its bowling facility to meet evolving customer expectations. With increasing competition in the entertainment industry and shifting user preferences toward immersive, tech-driven experiences, the club identified the need to upgrade its existing scoring system.

The project focused on implementing a modern, intuitive, and highly engaging scoring interface across 10 bowling lanes. The objective was not only to enhance the visual appeal and interactivity of the bowling experience but also to streamline backend operations and improve efficiency for staff. A critical requirement was ensuring seamless integration with the already installed third-party pinsetters, avoiding costly infrastructure replacement.

The transformation was successfully delivered by CSML Group through the deployment of the Brunswick SYNC Scoring System. The upgrade redefined the bowling experience by combining advanced technology and operational intelligence, ultimately positioning the club as a future-ready entertainment hub.

A great bowling experience begins long before the first roll; it starts with the quality, precision, and reliability of the equipment. From the moment a player picks up a ball to the satisfying sound of pins crashing, every detail shapes the overall experience. High-quality bowling consumables and equipment are not just operational necessities; they are the backbone of consistent performance, safety, and lasting customer satisfaction.

With a legacy of over 130 years, Brunswick Bowling has been instrumental in bringing the sport of bowling into the global spotlight. As one of the pioneers of modern bowling, Brunswick has continuously set industry benchmarks through innovation, durability, and performance-driven solutions. 

We understand that smooth gameplay, seamless operations, and minimal downtime depend heavily on selecting the right bowling essentials. Let’s explore how each component plays a vital role in ensuring your bowling center runs efficiently while delivering a truly premium experience. 

We, at CSML Group, take pride in being the exclusive distributor of original Brunswick balls, pins, shoes, and lane care essentials. Our commitment to quality ensures that every bowling center we support operates at the highest standards.

If you are looking to enhance performance, reduce maintenance challenges, and create a superior customer experience, connect with CSML Group today and build a bowling center that stands out.

I recently visited Timezone at R City Mall, and it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience! The gaming zone at Timezone is vibrant, well-maintained, and packed with a wide variety of games suitable for all age groups.

From arcade classics to modern interactive games, there’s something for everyone. We explored multiple games including racing simulators, basketball shootouts, air hockey, and a few skill-based arcade challenges. The machines were all in great condition, and the staff was helpful whenever needed, which made the overall experience smooth and enjoyable.

However, the highlight of our visit was definitely the bowling game! It was incredibly engaging and well-organized. What made it even more exciting was that we got 20 rounds with 10 balls per person, which gave us plenty of time to enjoy, compete, and improve our game. The setup was excellent, and the scoring system was easy to follow, making it fun even for beginners.

The atmosphere was lively, with great lighting and energetic vibes, making it a perfect place to unwind with friends or family. We genuinely had a great time laughing, competing, and just enjoying the moment.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and the bowling game truly made our visit special. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun outing in Ghatkopar
